# MenuProjection

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Formats` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public static class MenuProjection
```

Projects a loaded or peeked CookBook into the image-free [`MenuBook`](../nfty-ticket/Nfty.Ticket.MenuBook.md) the roll works on.

## Remarks

Cheap: it copies manifest records that are already in memory and opens no image. That is what lets `Generator` roll through `Ticketer` without a second walk of its own.

## Methods

### From(LoadedCookBook) { #m-from-nfty-core-formats-loadedcookbook }

```csharp
public static MenuBook From(LoadedCookBook book);
```

Projects a decoded book. The book keeps ownership of every image in it.

**Parameters**

- `book` (`LoadedCookBook`) - The loaded book.

**Returns.** Its image-free form.

### From(PeekedCookBook) { #m-from-nfty-core-formats-peekedcookbook }

```csharp
public static MenuBook From(PeekedCookBook book);
```

Projects a manifest-only book.

**Parameters**

- `book` (`PeekedCookBook`) - The peeked book.

**Returns.** Its image-free form.

**Remarks**

[`MenuBook.PartialAlpha`](../nfty-ticket/Nfty.Ticket.MenuBook.md#p-partialalpha) is taken straight from `book`'s own stored [`CookBookManifest.PartialAlpha`](../nfty-ticket/Nfty.Core.Model.CookBookManifest.md#p-partialalpha) here, unlike the [`LoadedCookBook`](Nfty.Core.Formats.LoadedCookBook.md) overload, which recomputes it from pixels. A peeked book decodes no image — that is the whole point of [`ArchivePeek`](Nfty.Core.Formats.ArchivePeek.md) — so there are no pixels to recompute from, and the same "trust the writer's stamp" rule [`ArchivePeek`](Nfty.Core.Formats.ArchivePeek.md) already follows for every other flag applies here too.
